tasks.name: GitHub Push
tasks.description: Create omni-hub repository on GitHub and push all code

step_1_git_init.command: git init && git config user.name/email && git add README.md deploy/Dockerfile deploy/docker-compose.yml github_push.sh run_omni_hub.py

step_2_git_commit.command: git commit -m 'OMNI-HUB v12.0-final: UNITY E=7641.82, 24 modules, 11-line SI'

step_4_git_push.command: git remote add origin https://github.com/omni-hub/omni-hub.git && git push -u origin main
step_4_git_push.error: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/omni-hub/omni-hub.git/': GnuTLS recv error (-110): The TLS connection was non-properly terminated.
step_4_git_push.note: Push failed because: (1) No GITHUB_TOKEN in environment, (2) Network/TLS restrictions in container

tasks.failure_analysis: GitHub API returned HTTP 401 'Requires authentication'. The environment contains no GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_API_KEY, or any GitHub authentication credential. Without authentication, repository creation and code push are impossible via both REST API and git HTTPS protocol.
required_to_fix: Set environment variable GITHUB_TOKEN with a valid personal access token (classic or fine-grained)
Token needs 'repo' scope for private repos or 'public_repo' scope for public repos
Alternative: Configure SSH key (~/.ssh/id_rsa) for git+ssh push

tasks.name: Cloudflare Deployment
tasks.description: Deploy OMNI-HUB as a Cloudflare Worker

step_2_worker_deploy.reason: Cannot deploy Worker without valid account credentials

tasks.failure_analysis: Cloudflare API returned error code 6003 'Invalid request headers' / 6111 'Invalid format for Authorization header'. The Bearer token was empty. No CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or CF_API_TOKEN environment variable exists. Cloudflare Workers deployment requires a valid API token with 'Cloudflare Workers:Edit' permission.
required_to_fix: Set environment variable CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN with a valid Cloudflare API token
Token must have 'Zone:Read' and 'Cloudflare Workers:Edit' permissions
Alternatively, use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID + CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY (Global API Key)

tasks.name: Supabase Database
tasks.description: Create Supabase project and knowledge pedestal schema

step_2_project_create.reason: Cannot create project without valid Supabase token

step_3_schema_create.reason: Cannot create schema without database connection

tasks.failure_analysis: Supabase API returned 'Format is Authorization: Bearer [token]' with empty token. No SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, SUPABASE_KEY, or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable exists. Supabase project creation and database schema deployment require authentication.
required_to_fix: Set environment variable SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN with a valid Supabase personal access token
Alternatively, use SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for direct database operations
Create project at https://app.supabase.com first, then use project-specific credentials

tables.name: knowledge_pedestal
tables.description: Core knowledge storage with quantum field coupling

recommendations: 1. Set GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable and re-run GitHub push task
2. Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN environment variable and re-run Cloudflare deployment task
3. Set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable and re-run Supabase database task
4. Consider using GitHub Actions workflow for automated deployment pipeline
5. Use wrangler CLI (npm install -g wrangler) for easier Cloudflare Workers deployment
6. Use supabase CLI for local development and schema management

next_steps.action: Obtain GitHub Personal Access Token from https://github.com/settings/tokens
Obtain Supabase Access Token from https://app.supabase.com/account/tokens
